== Notes ==
* [[Hero]]es and [[henchmen]] retreat from combat in order to use this skill.
* ''-40 armor'' results in double [[damage]] from skills that are affected by armor rating.
{{Anomaly|The armor penalty from this skill is applied after the [[Effect stacking#Effect caps|armor cap]] and the effects of [[Cracked Armor]] and [[armor penetration]].}}
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not [[health gain]].}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the release of [[Guild Wars Prophecies]], Healing Signet was planned to be a [[List of common skills|common skill]] (thus the colorless beta icon).
